messages:
maya: hey team — I need a quick JIT elevation for a canary push to prod (v2.14.3 pinned). change window 13:00-13:20 UTC. can someone approve?
chris: can you confirm it's only canary nodes and we have rollback ready?
maya: yes, canary only (10% traffic), rollback plan in the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/release/PR-824
chris: ok need MFA confirmation from the person who will press. who will be pressing?
samir: i can press, i'm oncall. will run canary then watch 5m health checks.
maya: @samir thanks. please note release notes include quantization changes — watch latency-slo and error-rate dashboards.
deploy-bot: request received: elevation for user samir to role deployer-temp (expires 20m). Please reply with `approve` + OTP.
samir: approve 842137 (OTP from 2FA app)
deploy-bot: elevation granted to samir until 1742508897. Audit ID: db-elev-2024-11-07-57.
alex: quick check — which service account will be used? we had svcacct/rel-runner rotated yesterday.
maya: using svcacct/deployer-canary (k8s secret rotated 11/6). alex, can you validate token expiry?
alex: ran `kubectl get secret deployer-canary -o yaml | grep expiry` — shows expiry 2025-01-01. good.
chris: also pin the model and runtime version in the deploy command: `--image redwood/runtime:v3.2.1 --model-id rdx-v2-14-3`
maya: done in the job manifest.
samir: starting canary deploy now. pushing with `./release.sh canary --pin v2.14.3`
oncall-bot: deploy started by samir at 13:03 UTC. canary instances: 12. health checks passing: 12/12.
samir: rolling traffic to 10% now. monitoring logs.
patti: remote question — do we have a safety rollback trigger? can we auto-rollback at >3% error spike?
maya: yes, autoslo rule exists: if 3m error-rate >3% or p95 latency >500ms we rollback and notify.
samir: seeing slight p95 blip to 420ms, within margin. continuing.
chris: please keep me in the loop. if anything odd, abort and pin previous v2.14.2.
samir: acknowledged.
deploy-bot: canary rollout completed to 10% at 13:07 UTC. No errors.
maya: great. scheduling full release for 13:15 if stable. any objections?
alex: one note — rotation of deployer keys next week, make sure we record that this release used deployer-canary.
patti: :thumbsup: no objections.
samir: proceeding with full push in 8 minutes. will follow the checklist.
oncall-bot: reminder: if a human triggers rollback, please run `/rollback v2.14.2 --reason <brief>` to ensure traceability.
maya: if rollback needed, log rollout actions and make a quick postmortem.
samir: full push executed at 13:15 UTC. post-deploy smoke OK. Metrics stable at 13:20 UTC.
chris: thanks. closing the elevation. @deploy-bot please revoke temp role.
deploy-bot: revocation scheduled. role deployer-temp for samir revoked at 13:22 UTC. Audit ID: db-revoke-2024-11-07-58.
maya: filing release notes and tagging the PR. good run team :tada:
